Above it the superior gluteal nerve runs between gluteus medius and minimus and is at risk

The Kocher-Langenbeck (posterior) approach to the hip/acetabulum proceeds through:

en.q: Why is femoral nerve injury rare in correct direct anterior approach?
o: It lies deep beneath the iliopsoas, lateral to the femoral artery — far from the sartorius/TFL interval
It is not present in this field
It travels through tensor fasciae latae
It is protected by the inguinal ligament
